Rollback-only Klaviyo report benchmark based on the byte-verified PR #378 writer. The Frankfurt Supabase Nano benchmark uses only the synthetic fixture with the tested retention and combined verification candidates. PostgreSQL server clocks cover five report staging calls and one publication call, excluding connection time, provider fixture creation, receipt re-read and job closure. Three runs in the same database session on 2026-11-18: 28.555039s, 28.586932s and 29.739403s (median 28.586932s). Each verified 1,000 rows, five report packages, one daily receipt and completion and was rolled back. Credentials are not stored in Git.

The median was 3.528629s below the separately collected baseline median. Each run verified 1,000 synthetic Klaviyo rows, five report packages, one daily receipt and completed job, then rolled back. The temporary session role was removed and the project was verified to have zero workspaces, report rows and work bindings.
